explanation: Clipping the cystic duct before achieving a full Critical View of Safety in a patient with a short cystic duct causes a common bile duct injury, though none of the cited cases (VID52_00731, VID75_00517, VID35_01263, VID110_00901, VID110_00921) resulted in bleeding. In those recorded transitions—all of which had 3/3 CVS—the surgeon next retracted the gallbladder (3/5 cases) or grasped the cystic duct (2/5 cases).
